HiVE Swarm per-level environment art — drop files here, game auto-loads them.

Naming (level N = 1..10):
  LN_path.png  — road tile, tiles/scrolls down the highway (any size, ~128-256px square reads best)
  LN_bg.png    — full backdrop, 540x960 (replaces the neon city skyline)
  LN_side.png  — side-area tile, fills the off-road areas left/right

Examples: L1_path.png, L1_bg.png, L1_side.png  (Level 1 "City Streets")
          L10_path.png ...                     (Level 10 "Inside the Hive")

Missing files are fine — the neon default stays. Level names are edited in
FORGE (F2) -> WORLD tab, where you also see live thumbnails of what's loaded.
